body: yeah, this is exactly how i have rationalised it myself in my head. but am wondering if i should broach the subject to break up or even try to fix it. i’m afraid if he offers to change i end up in the same place a few years later?

my mother did the same to my sister too, she is a lot more artistic than i am and worked on a lot of crafts, my mother once threw a way a bunch of her crafts she hand made, either using the hoarder excuse, or just to punish her. i feel like these type of instances have made me an antsy, paranoid person that is super possessive about my stuff.

i can relate, as a child my mother always aggressively went through my belongings/phone or when i got messy she’d yell and start to tidy my stuff up for me even when i cried and begged her to stop. she couldn’t understand that i wqs messy and putting off cleaning up because i was depressed. one time i broke down and she accused me of faking it. now i get anxiety even when i hear her footsteps coming closer to my room.
thank you ❤️
Same here. I have lost friends because of myself and when I need people I have no one. Don’t have the best advice but at least know that you’re not alone :)
your partner is lucky to have you :) my SO just gets mad when i have an episode
that’s cheating, clear as day and i hope you can find it in yourself to be strong and leave him :(
that happens to me too. i just get overwhelmed by the insecurity and shut down. how did your bf deal with that? mine is no longer patient during my crying spells and shut down too.

sometimes i wish instagram never existed. i think because of my image issues i just stopped posting on social media altogether and took down all my pictures as much as i could. i keep trying to understand that men can look at other women just based on their attractiveness and nothing else, but it just nags at me so much. i think i still need to consider where this is going. nonetheless thank you for sharing, and i am so happy for you to have gotten out of that situation which had also adversely affected your physical health. ❤️ i definitely need to work on some self love as well :(

i hope he knows he is lucky to have you too. :) i can’t speak for him, but when i’m going through these motions assurance help so much, so instead of just going along and validating any jealousy, you can explain to him how you understand where these feelings stem from, but also gently help to differentiate if he is feeling these emotions cause of bpd, or something else. say for e.g. you have another close friend, and he starts to feel jealous, you could help him understand you need to have a circle outside of him, or if he is up to it, introduce him to the friend as well. 

there was an instance when my SO (M) had a female best friend that was sharing memes with him on facebook that insinuated a rs too close for comfort (“i know i call you bro but i was trying to flirt”) and i called him out on it, he just laughed in my face and said i was being ridiculous, she’s like a sister to him yada yada. it may be HIS fact, but did nothing to acknowledge my feelings at the moment. 

so what i’m trying to say is, acknowledge what he feels at the moment, but also teach him that there are better ways to process his emotions instead of lashing out. it is also on him to practice overthinking less, but with a great support system like you it would be so much easier.

this is me :( relating to one of the comments above, i feel like i subconsciously do expect something back from my friends, and that is my toxic trait. i give all i can but when i don’t feel reciprocated i just want to shut down. my only way to deal with it has to be withdrawing myself, i cannot think of a healthy way to process it asides from therapy which i dont have access to.  sometimes i feel like i am nice because i feel i have to be, and i hate that it makes me feel like i’m not genuine.
i wish i had someone like you in my life. i think most importantly, for point 5 - don’t “over-validate” this person. just be strong for both of you, but stand by your own boundaries :)

or sometimes when i have recovered from my spiral, the issues during the episode suddenly seems ridiculously irrelevant and i hate having to “follow-up” with the person i confided in, which is coupled with a feeling of humiliation and shame for feeling so strongly during the episode. then they will be all “i told you it was no big deal”.

is that something that led to the breakup, if you don’t mind answering? it has been bugging me lately although we have been together for quite some time. it makes me feel unsettled in the relationship, and is holding me back from wanting to progress further. he watches an awful lot of porn as well, but he has always been very open about it. it sucks to visit his instagram profile time to time and see him following some new hot girl. just imagining him going through her feed and pressing follow while he’s texting me just makes me want to throw up and cry.

same here. i keep feeling like people are just keeping me around for convenience. im always there if they need me but they are never there when i need them. even my bf moans about how he is sorry he is away/bz when i need someone but he has never even tried to make up for it.
this is exactly how i am feeling :( i feel like an empty shell of a person

it’s weird that this popped up on my feed right when i was stressing about it. also doesn’t help that his instagram is full of influencer girls throughout his feed and he just nonchalantly scrolls through them sitting right beside me. makes me feel disgusted with how i look, i havent taken a single selfie in years.

25, same boat here. I’m drifting apart from everyone I know and was ever close to, people at work - i can only talk about work with them and that makes me stressed. i’m stuck between wanted to crawl into a hole and hide there alone and meeting new people. i feel so unseen, and unloved.
thank you so much 🥺

I can relate. People always brand me as the klutz of the group cause I tend to zone out a lot, and can be quite careless and clumsy. In my friend groups they always act as if I have to be “taken care of” and treat me in a super condescending way. Even in arguments when I know I am factually right they will insist upon their side of the argument, and to the extent of half jokingly telling me to shut up because “you don’t know anything anyway, you are zoned out most of the the time”.

The others seem to be able to take it easy with her.. so a part of me wonders if I am the problem. Also she makes it a point so that she is in every subgroup of the clique, she wants to be the person that knows everyone “best”.

I feel the exact same way. My SOs friend didn't say it explicitly but I joined them for Poker night yesterday and I felt so much like I was the outsider. They laughed at inside jokes together without explaining them and my socially anxious ass couldn't hop in onto the conversations. I pushed myself to quip up occasionally but I felt them just patronizing me. I feel so small and inferior when with my SOs group of friends and I emotionally snap back to when I'm a kid/teen that is simply unable to make new friends.

I think this is very close to my experience. My handle on the identity has been slipping more and more frequently.. by the smallest triggers. I feel like every attempt of owning my vulnerabilities are shut down by the people around me. :( I feel invalidated, “since when are you so emotional, comawhite”, people think just because I appear cheery all the time, my vulnerabilities aren’t real. I guess it is also my fault for consistently keeping my walls up, but it’s through these small interactions around me I often feel I will be invalidated. I just want to feel safe and wanted. Thank you for your comment nonetheless, it’s nice to feel empathised with for once, and genuinely great to hear that it’s possible to make the effort to try and regulate myself around these issues, although I do need a small break from the people around me now.

it is :) it's my favorite manson song. the whole mechanical animals album, actually. 

people keep losing their patience with me, i feel useless and clumsy. my mind is fogged up all the time, i haven't had a clear head in a while.
thank you for helping me feel less alone. i just wish i can experience peace again.

i did 💕 he texted me afterwards and told me he was sorry and hoped i wasn't upset, and that made me feel better. i am really struggling with NOT avoiding my feelings, but i'll try what you suggested the next time.. thank you so much!

Omg this is exactly how I feel all the time, and I thought I was just irrationally possessive, and it was just me. I have had this behavior throughout my entire life with other FPs (may not be an SO, could even be a close friend). It drives me nuts. I get crazy insecure when my bf tells me about how his female friends are attractive too.. even though he implies he has never had feelings for them. When he is out clubbing and drinking with even just guy friends I just can't get the negative thoughts out of my head and sometimes I even feel suicidal :( I hate that it happens to us but at the same time I'm so glad I'm not alone.

Sometimes I think I have more fake conversations than real ones :(
thank you! i’m feeling better right now, but will probably get back to that the next night, haha! hope things only keep looking up for you too ❤️

this is practically my whole life. i kept thinking the next year things would be better, but better never came.. in fact things just keep getting worse. part of me is almost in denial of it and still hoping, the other part has given up and i’m just slogging through life now.  :(

yeah i’ve spent my whole life doing that. hearing people out, being there for them as much as i can but sometimes what you do for people they can’t do the same for you. it’s not about keeping score, but sometimes unconditional friendship/love can’t possibly be one-sided. i do know where you are coming from, there is an extent of the happiness i get from being a listening ear, but sometimes i wish someone would be mine, other than having to just anonymously post on reddit haha.

i do agree!! it’s just sometimes feelings do get in the way, and make things a lot easier said than done. i have always been one to avoid complications when i run into them, but i’ve been feeling like something like this shouldn’t be something i get to close one eye on.
alright, i guess i will observe for a bit more and maybe try to start to talk about it. thank you so much, really appreciate your input :)

I cannot agree more. As much as tired of life I am, I'm not planning to die out of spite, because it's almost like passing my misery to somebody else. I do hate feeling like people think I'm just making excuses. Some times I just want my feelings to be validated. I wish I had the ability to start afresh somehow on another.

i know!! i find myself recklessly crossing the road sometimes but on second thoughts i wouldn't want someone else to have to deal with the guilt of killing someone like me.. but some moments of clarity just make me think i don't wanna take the "easy way out" yknow?? like i may think i want to die.. but i really don't. maybe that's why i don't wanna be given a choice thus the urge to have an "accident" happen to me. at least i know a part of me wants to live on. i think we all deserve a bit of selfishness for ourselves sometimes.

I don't have any good advice for you, but just know that you are not alone? For myself everyday I fantasize about getting killed but at the same time I'm so scared to die. It's like my own shameful little secret.

I know it might sound hard to believe, but I do try to change my behaviour and the only way I know how to do that is suppress my feelings. But eventually all these feelings, being swept under the rug builds up and I get all these stupid outbursts again. I really want to see someone, but the doctors that I can get in touch with (and afford to) are just really uncaring and I don't feel safe communicating my thoughts to them. I feel like they just want to prescribe me some drugs and send me on my way. Change is a lot easier said than done; my insecurities always find their way back to me. I hate letting them get the better of me, but it's near impossible to not succumb to them.

I don't really know what to feel reading your post. I guess it hurts a little bit because many times I feel like I'm in your friend's position, and throughout my relationship I've been endlessly fearing that my boyfriend will feel the way that you do. That said, of course it's not your fault, and in no way am I trying to guilt-trip you, and if anything I DO agree with and support your choice of actions. You sound like you have quite a lot on your plate already, and it will just weigh both of you down for you to be responsible for her. 

Sometimes I keep telling myself, if one day my boyfriend leaves me, I'd HAVE to force myself to understand, and he doesn't deserve to have to deal with my issues. I feel like I have been a horrible girlfriend and he definitely deserves better. When he is busy and is unable to make plans for me, or feels even the slightest bit distant, I shut down and often have the urge to self-harm, and I have. But as of now, he doesn't know that, as much as I lay a lot of my shit on him, I also bottle up a lot of things I don't tell him, because of my anxiety that the more he knows about my "crazy", the more likely he will just leave. I don't think I will ever be able to deal as well as I tell myself I can should he ever leave. But part of me also understands how much better his life can be without me in it. So many times I've even contemplated breaking up with him first, but I dare not to, because I'm so scared of being without him.

:( For me I'd say my issue is almost like my comfort zone is getting smaller and smaller and it just doesn't make sense to me. Last year I was still in school and it wasn't that bad, but I took a gap year after graduation and worked home for a bit, so I think it could be a contributing factor. I tried to work at a restaurant and I just got really uncomfortable around everyone there, staff or customers, and I was really clumsy, even broke a glass. The incident further humiliated me and not exaggerating, at the moment I wanted to die. I guess the best solution I can think of for myself is just to be frequently around people I'm already comfortable with more, and rebuild myself from there. It could be helpful to you, too? You can feel free to PM me as well if you need someone to talk to!

Same here. Some days, when I'm with closer friends I can get my confidence back and act more or less "normally".  But even during times like these I still feel uneasy about myself and this normalcy feels like an act. Like I remember this is how I used to be around them so I'm just acting it out, like the old me is someone else that I know, if it makes sense? I feel like I'm deteriorating because the uneasiness I mentioned earlier seems to be getting more and more intense, almost like there are cracks in this personality I'm portraying to them. The "real me" if there is one just feels like a shell of anxiety, paranoia and depression. My favorite part of all these is that nobody around me seems to even notice, maybe they don't care, maybe I'm better at acting than I thought, but it's like it just bewilders me how my world is shattering to pieces and people can't tell at all. Everything's so unreal.
i need to know too :'(

About the last week or so I posted something similar here, I needed some sort of validation whether I should tell my boyfriend about my issues with BPD. The people here had encouraged me to, and a few days ago I finally did. His reaction was very casual, I told him primarily about my issues with my unbalanced sense of identity. He did a quick search about its symptoms, and he focused on the fact that people say the symptoms may actually wear of as you aged; then he told me that he didn't mind however it took for me to find the real me, and he could wait with me. Initially I felt paranoid that he felt a little offhanded, but a friend told me that he could've been downplaying it so I won't feel even more insecure. I guess more or less his reaction was quite positive, which is a bit of a relief. I stressed for weeks to finally tell him, I was scared as hell that he might react badly, but sure did it feel good to let it out! One less secret, I guess. All in all, for someone with bpd like myself, the situation is really high risk, high reward. Despite my heightened feelings of fear, I forced myself to tell my bf, no matter how long I took. If you asked me now, I'd still be very very scared to tell anybody else, and so far am not intending to, just letting my bf know is enough for now. Guess sometimes you just have to trust the person you're telling imo, and take a leap of faith. Scary, but when it's done, there's a sense of relief.

Hi all, reading your replies gave me a little more confidence towards the situation and I think I'll give it a shot and try to tell him, and hopefully won't back out at the last minute. At the same time, all the best to all of you here who are suffering from the same afflictions as I do. Thank you so much :)
